title: Fulfillment Event
description: Append-only fulfillment event representing an actual shipment. References line items by ID.
description_pt: Evento de fulfillment somente-anexação representando um envio real. Referencia itens de linha por ID.

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when this fulfillment event occurred.
occurred_at.description_pt: Timestamp RFC 3339 de quando este evento de fulfillment ocorreu.

type.description: Fulfillment event type. Common values include: processing (preparing to ship), shipped (handed to carrier), in_transit (in delivery network), delivered (received by buyer), failed_attempt (delivery attempt failed), canceled (fulfillment canceled), undeliverable (cannot be delivered), returned_to_sender (returned to merchant).
type.description_pt: Tipo de evento de fulfillment. Valores comuns incluem: processing (preparando para envio), shipped (entregue à transportadora), in_transit (na rede de entrega), delivered (recebido pelo buyer), failed_attempt (tentativa de entrega falhou), canceled (fulfillment cancelado), undeliverable (não pode ser entregue), returned_to_sender (devolvido ao merchant).

id.description_pt: Referência ao ID do item de linha.

line_items.description: Which line items and quantities are fulfilled in this event.
line_items.description_pt: Quais itens de linha e quantidades são cumpridos neste evento.

tracking_number.description: Carrier tracking number (required if type != processing).
tracking_number.description_pt: Número de rastreamento da transportadora (obrigatório se type != processing).

tracking_url.description: URL to track this shipment (required if type != processing).
tracking_url.description_pt: URL para rastrear este envio (obrigatório se type != processing).

description.description: Human-readable description of the shipment status or delivery information (e.g., 'Delivered to front door', 'Out for delivery').
description.description_pt: Descrição legível por humanos do status do envio ou informação de entrega (ex.: 'Entregue na porta da frente', 'Saiu para entrega').
